title: polystichopsis lurida
intro: Polystichopsis lurida, commonly known as the Golden Spleenwort, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include its ability to promote digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polystichopsis lurida include its potential to support liver function, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are still being studied for their potential health benefits.
